name: weather-assistant
description: Voice-enabled weather intelligence & live mapping dashboard with automated Doxygen documentation.

scripts.docs:generate: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { execSync('doxygen docs/Doxyfile', { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, PATH: process.env.PATH.split(':').filter(p => !p.includes('node_modules')).join(':') } }); } catch(e) { require('doxygen').run('docs/Doxyfile'); }"
